{{dablink|For other uses of the words "wind" and "rising," see [[Wind]] and [[Rising]].}}
'''Low Wind Rising''' is a [[sword form]]. It has both a standing and a seated version. [[Rand al'Thor]] used the seated version of this form when testing [[Laman Damodred]]'s sword that was given to him by [[Aviendha]] to slice a silk cushion in half.{{ref/book|5|21}}
